tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Responsive inventory grid opening into dense item detail. Price, condition, seller, delivery, and trust information remain separable in repeated listings.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Humanist sans type keeps instructions and repeated controls approachable without softening their meaning. Shared patterns support two roles with different decisions and responsibilities.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Policies, status, and safeguards appear close to consequential actions.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Layouts tolerate uneven photography, long titles, and sparse or rich item data.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Marketplace listing rhythm with item image, price, trust, and delivery hierarchy. Photography needs an explicit subject, crop, rights basis, and decision role.
